comments.body: 2026-10-24: on main in 104ac998. Checked from local transcripts and the clear corpus that /clear starts a new session id. The statusline names its session with the new report --context-session (protocol 1.8, Report field 14); a report naming another session forgets context and cost first. pane restart still resumes by the hook's session id.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-10-17 on a pane whose Claude Code had Muster's statusline but not its plugin. After `/clear` the ring stayed half full and `muster window` still said `context_used: 49`, while the statusline itself drew 0%.

After `/clear`, Claude Code's statusline JSON holds no `context_window.used_percentage` until the next message (inferred: the statusline's `// 0` drew 0% and the daemon kept 49). `report --from` leaves a null out on purpose, since it means unknown rather than empty, so the daemon keeps the last session's value. Only the plugin's SessionStart hook (matcher `startup|clear`) runs `report --clear`. Even with the plugin, a statusline report that started before the clear and lands after it would leave the same stale value, since no later report carries a context either (read from the code, not seen).

Likely fix: the statusline also sends `--from session-id=/session_id`, and the daemon forgets the context and cost reported under another session id. That needs no hooks and covers `/resume` into another session too. Check first that `/clear` gives the session a new id (believed, not verified), and what changes once the statusline names the session id, since `pane restart` resumes by the id the SessionStart hook reports today.
title: A Claude Code pane keeps its old context ring after /clear
